assertion.en: Most meteors burn up in the mesosphere.

reason.en: They are already very hot when they arrive from space.

a.en: The Reason is false. Space is cold, so the rock is not hot when it arrives.

b.en: The Reason is false, not just unrelated. A meteor is cold until it reaches the air.

d.en: The Assertion is true. The mesosphere, 50 to 80 km high, is where most of them burn up.

explanation.en: The Assertion is true and the Reason is false. A meteor arrives cold. It moves so fast that the air ahead of it is squeezed and becomes very hot, and this turns the rock to vapour.

hints.en: Decide on each statement alone first.
